gotchas: Annual fee / renewal fee row for Cashback SBI Card is stated as ₹999, with renewal fee waived off on annual spends of ₹2 lakh or more in the preceding year. The fee row is shown in the MITC fee table, which also lists other cards. Source: sbi_common_mitc.pdf p.4-6.

Eligible spends incurred on the Credit Card within the last 365 days from the Annual Card Fee billing date shall be considered for the spend-based reversal of the Annual Card fees. Source: sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.42.
Cashback is not applicable on transactions less than ₹100. Source: sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.36-37.

Cashback is not earned on balance transfers, balance transfer on EMIs, cash advances, financial charges, disputed transactions, encash, ATM withdrawals, wallet loading, rent/property management, jewelry, school and educational services, card/gift/novelty/souvenir shops, railways, member financial institution/quasi cash, digital gaming platforms/merchants, tolls, government-related transactions, payments made using Standing Instructions / Fetch and Pay on SBI Card platforms, Flexipay transactions, and Merchant EMI transactions. The revision notice adds that cashback will not be applicable on Digital Gaming Platforms/Merchants, Tolls and Government-related Transactions, in addition to existing exclusions. Source: sbi_cashback_revision_2026-04.pdf p.1.

Cashback is credited within two working days of statement generation, and for the current billing statement month is credited in the next billing statement month on statement generation date plus two days. Source: sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.34; p.36.
Cashback is calculated on posting/settlement date, not transaction date. Source: sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.14.
Cashback is rounded down for each individual transaction. Source: sbi_cashback_tnc.pdf p.37.

- i) The cashbacks earned/reversed during a billing statement month will be visible in the monthly credit card billing statement.

- j) Maximum Card Cashback that can be earned on online and offline spends in a statement cycle is capped at ₹4,000. Post reaching the capping limit, cardholder will not earn any cashback for that statement cycle.

Ans: The maximum cashback that may be earned on online transactions in a statement cycle is `2,000. The maximum cashback that may be earned on Offline transactions in a statement cycle is `2,000. Under no circumstances shall the aggregate cashback in a single statement cycle exceed `4,000.

- For example: If your statement generation date is 11th July, the transactions posted from 12th June to 11th July will be considered under this statement cycle and all eligible online transactions during this period will accrue 5% Cashback and all eligible offline transactions will accrue 1% Cashback. - Note: Card Cashback is accrued on posting/settlement date of transaction and not on effective date of transaction and accordingly Card Cashback will get accrued on account as per applicable cashback structure at the time of transaction posting.

## 11. CARD CASHBACK

11.1 Card Cashback Program

- a) SBI Card Cashback Program (“the Program”) allows eligible CASHBACK SBI Card (“Cardholder/s”) to earn Card Cashback from spending on their CASHBACK SBI Card, as determined by SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited (“SBICPSL”) from time to time. Card Cashback earned on such SBI Card is directly credited to the SBI Card account within two working days of the statement generation.

- b) The cashbacks will be processed according to the following table:

|Spends|Cashback|
|---|---|
|Online Spends|5%|
|Offline Spends|1%|

c) Online Spends will be identified basis the online indicators sent by Card Networks (VISA, Rupay. Etc.) and acquirer. Any transaction not categorized as online would be termed as offline. The MCCs are defined by the networks and are subjected to change basis their discretion and such changes shall be implemented basis communication from the Networks without any requirement for intimation/information to the customers.

- d) Cashback shall not be earned for following spends/transactions on the card,

- Any purchases at petrol pumps/service stations (MCCs: 5172, 5541, 5542, 5983)

- Balance transfers, Balance Transfer on EMIs

- Cash advances

- Financial charges (e.g., late payment fee, dishonored cheque charges, service fee, transaction charges etc.)

- Disputed transactions

- Encash

- ATM Withdrawals

- E wallet loading transactions identified under MCCs 6540 and 6541

- Payments towards Rent/property management under MCCs 6513 and 7349

13.2 Terms & Conditions for Card Upgrade

- Annual Fee is payable on the annual card fee date of the current card which will be communicated to you through your monthly statement. Upgrade of the current card has no bearing on your card fee date.

- Eligible spends incurred on the Credit Card within the last 365 days from the Annual Card Fee billing date shall be considered for the spend-based reversal of the Annual Card fees.

- GST will be charged over and above the annual fee basis the prevailing GST rate.

- A cardholder will be eligible for welcome gift only post payment / realization of annual fee by SBI Card.

- The credit limit enhancement on the new card will be at the sole discretion of SBI Card.

- In case the card is flipped from core to core card, the Reward Points accumulated on the previous card will automatically be transferred onto the new card.

- In case the card is upgraded / flipped from core to co brand card, customer needs to use all his reward points before raising the request for card upgrade / flipping.

- In case the card is upgraded / flipped from co brand to core card, customer will not be allowed to move his reward points.

- The upgrade would be offered to eligible customer’s basis the internal evaluation/parameters of customer performance and credit history on the card.

- Old card plastic will be active for a period of 90 days from the date of upgrade to new card.

- Post the downgrade of the upgraded card, customer is not eligible to upgrade the card for a period of 6 months from the date of downgrade.

- Downgrade may be initiated by a customer only within a period of 90 days post upgrading the existing SBI Card.
